key_insight: Friction stir welding joined 1-mm NiTi to AA6061-T6, produced mixed results with AA2024-T3, and failed to join AA7075-T6 under tested conditions.
engineering_relevance: Alloy selection is critical when integrating shape-memory NiTi with aerospace aluminum structures using dissimilar butt joints.
method: Friction stir weld NiTi sheet to three aluminum alloys.
Evaluate joint tensile strength and fracture behavior.
Examine stir-zone particles and weld interfaces by microscopy.
evidence_signal: AA6061–NiTi joints averaged 167.8 MPa ultimate tensile strength and 57.9% weld efficiency, versus 120 MPa and 27.6% for AA2024–NiTi joints.
watch_item: Post-weld cracking in AA2024 and AA7075 was attributed to residual stresses and thermal-expansion mismatch combined with lower alloy ductility.
paper_title: Exploration of friction stir welding butted thin sheet NiTi with AA6061, AA2024, and AA7075
